confidence_notes: Overall medium. Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on aggregated guides and Numbeo-derived Portugal ranges (medium). Beer, cocktail and wine rest on travel blogs with thin Porto-specific data (low to medium). Accommodation anchors are knowledge-based holistic estimates for Porto in peak summer, not checked against live listings (low). EUR figures were converted to USD at an approximate 1.16 from general knowledge, not from a search. The FX observation is the most recent RBA figure I could confirm (2026-03-20, from a search summary of the RBA page). It is not a current observation and may be stale for the 2026-10-16 generation date.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city substitution. Food and drink anchors use Porto-specific guide prices, with Portugal-wide Numbeo ranges where Porto data was thin. Cocktail and wine are set against the beer price level, since the cocktail and wine sources were sparse. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate for Porto in summer, not from live listings.
